## Clinical justification

This patient has persistent dyspepsia unresponsive to an eight-week trial of a PPI at standard dose. She reports persistent nausea and occasional vomiting. She has lost approximately four kilograms over the same period. I am making this urgent suspected cancer referral in line with NICE guidance. Amylase and LFTs are enclosed. Gallstones were excluded on ultrasound three years ago.
